title: The Redux Framework plugin for WordPress is vulnerable to Stored Cross-Site Scripting via the…
description: The Redux Framework plugin for WordPress up to version 4.5.17 is vulnerable to stored cross-site scripting (XSS) via a specific parameter due to insufficient input sanitization and output escaping. Authenticated users with subscriber-level access or higher can inject malicious scripts that execute when other users view the injected content. Exploitation requires an administrator to take an action to trigger the vulnerability, limiting direct attacker control. The vulnerability arises because the sanitization method wp_kses_post() is bypassed by using allowed HTML tags and attributes with encoded event handlers that become active when processed by WordPress's thickbox.js.
